questions.q: Under India's Universal Immunisation Programme, BCG is given:
questions.why: With OPV-0 and hepatitis B birth dose.

questions.q: An elderly patient with a sudden severe headache, 'worst ever', and neck stiffness may have:
questions.why: Topic 7, Practice of Medicine. Needs urgent CT scanning.

questions.q: Air under the diaphragm on an erect chest X-ray indicates:
questions.why: Pneumoperitoneum, as in perforated peptic ulcer.

questions.q: Constipation with ineffectual urging, irritability and oversensitivity in sedentary people who overuse stimulants calls for:
questions.why: Topic 7, Practice of Medicine. Nux: frequent ineffectual urging.

questions.q: Chronic cough with fever, night sweats, weight loss and haemoptysis most suggests:
questions.why: Topic 7, Practice of Medicine. Test sputum for TB.

questions.q: Skin scrapings are examined for fungal hyphae in suspected dermatophytosis after treatment with:
questions.why: KOH (10 to 20%) digests keratin so that fungal hyphae can be seen in direct mounts of skin, hair and nail.

questions.q: Bone growth problems, slow fontanelle closure and pains at the junction of bones in a thin, growing child suggest:
questions.why: Topic 2, Materia Medica. Calc phos: thin, tall children, growing pains.

questions.q: Foot drop follows injury to the:
questions.why: It winds around the neck of the fibula and supplies the dorsiflexors.

questions.q: Erythropoietin is produced mainly by the:
questions.why: Topic 5, Anatomy and Physiology. In response to hypoxia.

questions.q: Chikungunya is characterised by fever with:
questions.why: Topic 6, Pathology, Microbiology and Diagnostics. The name means 'that which bends up'.
